sentences.text: Helicampodus was a member of the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fish.
The genus Helicampodus was described by Branson in 1935.
Helicampodus was formerly classified in the families Helicoprionidae and Edestidae but is now placed in Helicampodontidae.
The parent group of Helicampodus is the family Helicampodontidae.
This animal lived during the Late Permian to Early Triassic periods.
Fossils of Helicampodus have been found in Asia.
